description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for a WebSocket endpoint, including parameters like queue size, buffer size, throttling factor, and associated configuration rendering and default values.

classes.name: WebsocketConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for WebSocket, including methods to retrieve queue sizes, buffer sizes, throttling factors, and rendering configuration into a Config object.

classes.name: WebsocketConfig.WebsocketConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and default values for WebsocketConfig.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Converts the WebsocketConfig object into a Config object for configuration management.

methods.name: getSubscriberBackpressureQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum queue size for inflight commands per WebSocket client.

methods.name: getPublisherBackpressureBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer size for outstanding command responses and events per WebSocket client.

methods.name: getThrottlingRejectionFactor
methods.description: Returns the factor of maximum throughput at which rejections are sent.

methods.name: getThrottlingConfig
methods.description: Returns the throttling configuration object for WebSocket.
